alien.arch.description: Natural rock arch: two leaning eroded legs and a sagging octagonal span swept along an arc, in strata rock (cliff role). A landmark gateway for alien regions.

alien.boulder.description: Faceted alien boulder: a jittered low sphere in violet basalt strata (rock role), flattened underside.

alien.bulb.description: Glow-bulb plant: curved stems ending in round glowing bulbs (light role) over a rosette of broad lens leaves.

alien.cap_tree.description: Cap tree: curving tapered stalks carrying wide umbrella caps with gilled undersides and glowing spots (cap role), a ring of root knuckles at the base.

alien.crystal.description: Crystal cluster: faceted hexagonal crystals with glowing tips leaning out of a low basalt foot; every crystal is its own node.

alien.frond.description: Fan frond: long curved blade leaves (diamond-section sweeps) fanning out of a bulbous core, teal with spore-lit veins (foliage role).

alien.geode.description: Split geode: a half-buried faceted rock bowl (closed thick shell, rock outside, crystal-lined inside) with glowing crystal points standing in its hollow.

alien.grass.description: Alien grass clump: thin twisting three-sided blades leaning out of a tuft, tips spore-lit (flower role).

alien.rock_spire.description: Rock spire (hoodoo): stacked eroded tiers narrowing upward with pinched waists and a wide balanced cap rock (rock role).

alien.spire.description: Crystal spire: a tall leaning six-sided monolith crystal with a glowing crown band and tip, small satellite crystals and a split basalt foot. A landmark for alien regions.

alien.tendril.description: Tendril coral: a colony of leaning lathed tubes with flared glowing mouths (light role rims), magenta-coral skin (cap role).

planet.crater.description: Crater tile (8 m): a bowl with a raised rim (rim faces rock role) inside a flat-edged regolith tile.

planet.dune.description: Dune tile (8 m): wind ridges with a sharp crest and soft lee slope running east-west, fading to flat ground on every edge (sand role, crests path role for a lighter tone).

planet.ground.description: Planet ground tile (8 m): closed regolith slab, gently undulating inside and flat at its level on all four edges, optional low rock bumps (rock role). Interlocks with any tile whose edge is ground at the same level.

planet.mesa.description: Mesa: a flat-topped strata plateau with tapering eroded sides and a ledge band (cliff sides, sand top), a landmark for alien regions; stands on the ground anywhere off the tile grid.

planet.pad.description: Landing pad tile (8 m): flat ground tile carrying a round bevelled hex-plated pad (floor role) with a hazard ring and up to four beacon posts with glowing heads. Interlocks as level-0 ground.

planet.ridge.description: Ridge tile (8 m): flat ground on the south half rising in a steep strata cliff (cliff role) to the 6 m plateau level on the north edge, the face broken into buttresses and gullies with rim bumps behind the crest; a backdrop wall for alien regions that interlocks with plateau tiles at level 6 and with other ridges cliff to cliff.

planet.rise.description: Rise tile (8 m): a smooth ramp from level 0 on the south edge to level 2 (or 6) on the north edge; east/west edges follow the shared ramp profile, steep cells take the cliff role.

planet.trail.description: Trail tile (8 m): a 2.4 m packed trail (path role) worn slightly into flat-edged ground, crossing the tile on the trail edges; neighbours must carry the trail on the shared edge.

ship.drone.description: Service drone (0.9 m): lathed saucer body with a sensor eye, three thruster rings on short arms, resting on three small feet; cargo variant clutches a crate.

ship.escape_pod.description: Escape pod (2.7 m): faceted octagonal cone capsule with a scorched heat-shield skirt, three fin legs, a round side hatch (open variant swings it aside over a dark opening) and a beacon light on top.

ship.hauler.description: Cargo hauler (12 m): long chamfered spine with a bubble cab at the nose, clamp frames carrying up to four cargo pods with hazard bands, four rear nacelles and tapered landing legs. Original silhouette.

ship.rover.description: Planet rover (4.6 m): raised chamfered chassis with a slant-glass cab, cargo deck with a light bar, sensor mast and dish, six (or four) lathed wheels with hub caps.

ship.shuttle.description: Small shuttle (6.6 m): blunt-nosed octagonal wedge with a dorsal spine, slanted canopy, downswept stub wings ending in round tip pods, twin rear thrusters with glowing bells and landing skids (optional belly cargo pod). Original silhouette.

skyx.horizon.description: Horizon ring: an inward silhouette ring around the viewer (v = 0 at the base .. 1 at the crest so the pack's vista haze gradient paints it): flat-topped mesas, needle spires or dunes, original alien skylines.

skyx.nebula.description: Nebula band: a gently curved inward card (role view: painted star field, nebula and planet) placed beyond big windows and hangar mouths for parallax depth.

skyx.planet.description: Sky planet: a smooth banded sphere (10 x 6, painted terminator in the texture) hanging over the horizon, optionally ringed; moons are small presets. Place with the room backdrop or as a region piece far out.

skyx.starfield.description: Star-field sky: inward-facing dome (or cylinder) carrying the pack's painted sky (role sky, v = elevation 0..1): deep space with nebula wisps and stars on space_station, the painted alien sky on alien_world.

stn.airlock.description: Airlock leaves for the 2.0 x 2.6 doorway cut (insert piece, flag-swapped closed -> open): two white leaves with a hazard-striped zig-zag seal and a round lock hub. Origin on the door anchor like stn.doorway.

stn.bridge.description: Bridge / cockpit shell on a 3x3-cell plot: the side walls angle in toward a faceted front viewport band (star-field card beyond, mullions, sill ledge), back door on the south side cell 1, panelled ceiling with a light ring. Origin on the cell-block centre.

stn.bulkhead.description: Heavy bulkhead frame ring across a corridor on a cell edge: follows the chamfered section, thicker at the base, hazard lip inside. Origin on the cell-edge midpoint (frame centred on the boundary).

stn.ceiling.description: Room ceiling for stn.room / stn.hangar plots: one-sided panel sheet facing down (cameras above see in), recessed light panels and tapered beams. Origin on the cell-block centre at floor level (geometry at the ceiling height).

stn.corridor.description: Station corridor cell (4 m, 3 m clear, 3.2 m high): chamfered octagonal section, mitred one-sided walls with a recessed light band, floor and ceiling sheets, cap ledges for the cutaway; corridor sockets on open cell-edge midpoints.

stn.doorway.description: Bulkhead doorway frame for a 2.0 x 2.6 door cut: chamfered steel frame with a hazard lip, raised sill and a card behind the opening. Origin on the room.gd door anchor (0.6 m behind the inner wall face); room.gd places it on every door through the arch.door binding.

stn.floor.description: Deck tile for one cell laid over a room floor: raised bevelled hex plates, a framed grate, a plain bevelled deck plate or a circular marked pad. Origin on the cell centre.

stn.hangar.description: Hangar bay shell (7 m high): tall chamfered walls with a high light band, a wide north mouth open to space (star-field card, heavy chamfered frame with hazard lips), painted landing ring on the hex deck, crew door on the south wall. Ceiling: stn.ceiling height 7. Origin on the cell-block centre.

stn.lift.description: Lift platform for one cell: bevelled round platform with a hazard rim, tapered guide columns, a top guide ring with a light band and a call post on the front. Origin on the cell centre.

stn.room.description: Station room shell: deck floor + mitred one-sided chamfered walls (kick chamfer, panels, light band, upper chamfer to a 4 m ceiling line) with door / viewport cuts on side-cell midpoints and pilaster ribs. Ceiling: stn.ceiling. Origin on the cell-block centre.

stn.stairs.description: Stairs, ramp or dais for raised decks (command platforms, catwalk ends): one solid zig-zag flight with grille treads, tapered side stringers, tube handrails on posts. Origin on the footprint centre.

stn.viewport.description: Viewport window for a room-wall cut: chamfered frame (depth through the wall), sill ledge and a star-field card behind (dark space, nebula, a distant violet planet). Origin on the wall anchor (0.6 m behind the inner face, side-cell midpoint, floor level); the card reaches the floor behind the wall.

tech.cables.description: Cable run: a bundle of tube cables (wavy on the floor or sagging between bracket posts) ending in chamfered junction boxes; cables never interpenetrate (laterally offset).

tech.charge_pod.description: Robot charging pod: curved alcove wall with a canopy and light strips, a round contact pad with a glowing ring, and (optional) a dormant service robot of original design (dome head, visor, stubby arm pods) docked on it. Alcove opens to -Y.

tech.console.description: Operator console: chamfered plinth, tapered body set back from the toes, slanted desk with painted emissive screens and a light strip, side fins; tall adds a leaning back display. Operator side -Y.

tech.crate.description: Cargo crate: chamfered bevelled box with corner bumpers and an optional hazard band; stack piles a small crate on a large one (2 mm gap, no interpenetration).

tech.cryo_pod.description: Standing cryo pod: hexagonal plinth with a light band, elliptic lathed capsule, oval glass window on the front, two hoses from the domed cap into the back. open swings the window door aside.

tech.holo_table.description: Holo-table stand: hexagonal lathe with a wide foot, tapered neck and flared top, a light rim and an emitter disc; an optional small globe hovers over the emitter (a static prop, no hologram shader).

tech.locker.description: Locker bank against a wall (back on y = 0 before centring): chamfered carcass with a sloped top, raised doors with vent slots and grip bars, a label strip per door.

tech.reactor.description: Reactor column: stepped round plinth with a hazard ring, a glowing core cylinder inside tapered cage ribs, coil rings and a domed top cap.

tech.seat.description: Command seat: tapered hex swivel base, upholstered seat and tilted backrest with a headrest wing, armrests with small emissive panels. Faces -Y.

tech.tank.description: Pressure tank: lathed capsule with domed ends and two painted bands, a valve wheel, standing on a hex foot ring (upright) or two tapered saddles (horizontal).

tech.terminal.description: Info terminal: a tapered pillar (stand) or a wall panel with a tilted emissive screen, a keypad ledge and a status light.

tech.vent.description: Vent: chamfered frame, recessed grille plate and a three-blade fan hub behind it. wall stands on the floor against a wall (back on y = 0); floor lies in the deck.

note: Every GLB here exists for consumers only with this sha256 (explicit sRGB8, converted after the kit validators and the SCIFIKIT gates ran on the linear build; source_sha256 = validated build). textures are relative to kits/library/.
